source: https://github.com/Siteimprove/alfa, folder packages/alfa-rules (src/sia-*/rule.ts, src/tags/, src/rules.ts, src/deprecated.ts, src/experimental.ts, package.json)
method: Each packages/alfa-rules/src/sia-*/rule.ts was read as plain text (no repository code was run) and parsed with regular expressions: kind from Rule.Atomic.of / Rule.Composite.of; criteria, techniques, EAA clauses, ARIA and best-practice requirements from the Criterion/Technique/EAA/ARIA/BestPractice.of("...") calls inside the requirements array; tags from the tags array; questions from Question.of("...") calls in the rule file and, transitively, in the local helper modules it imports under src/common (type-only imports ignored); composite rules inherit the questions of the rules they compose. uses_oracle is true when the rule asks at least one question or imports Question. Descriptions come from a leading comment in rule.ts when present, otherwise from the first passing outcome message (Ok.of(...)) in the rule file or in its imported helper. The act field is filled only when a rule file names an ACT rule id, which none does.
notes: uses_oracle: the rule can ask a question, directly, through a shared helper in src/common, or through a rule it composes; without an oracle those outcomes are cantTell. It does not mean that every outcome of the rule needs an answer.

questions_may_be_auto_answered: the rule or its helpers call .answerIf(...), so Alfa answers the question itself when it can compute the answer (for example text colours for the contrast rules) and asks the oracle only otherwise.
act: no rule file names an ACT rule id, so the field is always empty. The mapping from ACT rules to sia-r ids is published in the W3C ACT implementation reports, not in this repository.
stability: for three rules the Stability tag and the export list disagree (see summary.stability_tag_vs_export_list_mismatches); stability_by_export_list and the summary follow the export list.
sia-er8 and sia-er87 are experimental version-2 rules that share the uri of sia-r8 and sia-r87; sia-dr* are deprecated rules that keep the uri of the original rule number.
Seven rules have no requirements field at all (sia-r23, sia-r26, sia-r29, sia-r31, sia-r54, sia-r98, sia-r101); the media rules among them only feed composite rules, which carry the criteria.
eaa: clause numbers of EN 301 549 as declared with EAA.of(...) from @siteimprove/alfa-eaa.

tag_vocabulary.Version: Version.N (version 1 is assumed when the tag is missing, per packages/alfa-rules/README.md)

summary.note: Effective stability = export list (src/rules.ts = stable, src/deprecated.ts, src/experimental.ts); it differs from the Stability tag only for the rules listed in stability_tag_vs_export_list_mismatches.
